title: SurvX: Survival and Competing Risks Analysis with Direct Parametric Models for the Cumulative Incidence Function
description: R package for survival and competing-risks analysis with a dependency-free C++ core: direct parametric models for the cumulative incidence function (Jeong-Fine joint PH/PO/GOR, the constrained model of Shi et al.), Fine-Gray and cause-specific Cox models, Aalen-Johansen estimation, prediction performance (Brier, IPA, time-dependent AUC, calibration) and the simulation code of the accompanying article.
